q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a CCTV camera?
title: CCTV camera carbon footprint per camera
short: Most of the footprint is in bought-in electronics: use supplier figures for the image sensor board, lens and housing. Add surface mount and assembly energy, then divide the plant's energy by cameras made.

ul: Image sensor, processor board and IR LEDs.
Plastic or aluminium housing, cable and bracket.
Surface mount assembly if done in-house.

p: Report per camera by type, since a metal-bodied outdoor camera carries more housing than an indoor dome.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per camera (one month)
lines: Plant total: 21,300 / 40,000 = 0.532 kg CO2 per camera
Add boards, lens and housing for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
